narratives.headline: Can Messi Defend the Crown?
narratives.summary: At 38, Messi leads Argentina into uncharted territory — defending a World Cup title. No team has repeated since Brazil in 1962. The supporting cast is stronger than ever, but the weight of expectation is immense.

narratives.headline: The Mbappé Era Begins
narratives.summary: Mbappé enters his prime with a France squad built around his speed and finishing. After a hat-trick in the 2022 final, he's hungry for the one trophy that eluded him — a second star for France.

narratives.headline: USA's Home Advantage
narratives.summary: Hosting alongside Canada and Mexico, the USA has a golden opportunity. With a young, athletic squad and home crowds, can they surpass the quarterfinal ceiling from 2002?

narratives.headline: Africa's Time to Shine?
narratives.summary: Morocco broke the semifinal barrier in 2022. Now Senegal, Algeria, and a deeper African contingent believe a World Cup can be won by an African nation for the first time.

narratives.headline: 48 Teams, 104 Matches — The Biggest Ever
narratives.summary: The expanded format means more drama, more Cinderella stories, and more pressure on the favorites. The new Round of 32 adds an extra knockout stage — and more chances for chaos.
